name: FLAG_OFF
trigger: flag enabled unexpectedly or any threshold breach
procedure: set Stage 1 flag OFF and confirm effective traffic 0
verification: flag OFF, selected count stops, primary unaffected
recovery_criteria: all critical counters stable at zero; manual reapproval required

name: LANE_KILL_SWITCH
verification: affected lane submissions stop; other lane and primary remain intact
recovery_criteria: lane root cause corrected and lane-specific approval renewed

name: GLOBAL_SHADOW_DISABLE
verification: all shadow submissions stop and traffic is 0
recovery_criteria: incident closed and all six blocking approvals renewed

name: CONFIG_ROLLBACK
verification: configuration digest restored; flag remains OFF
recovery_criteria: configuration independently reviewed and exact-head bound

name: DEPLOYMENT_ROLLBACK
procedure: roll back isolated non-production deployment image
verification: previous image digest active; no shadow execution
recovery_criteria: deployment verification and rollback review pass

name: CREDENTIAL_REVOKE
procedure: revoke workload credential and invalidate leases
verification: credential rejected and no task can authenticate
recovery_criteria: new short-lived credential issued after Privacy/Security approval

name: NETWORK_ROUTE_REVOKE
trigger: production route detection or network policy failure
procedure: remove route and deny egress at network boundary
verification: route unreachable and production detection remains zero
recovery_criteria: network drill passes and SC explicitly reauthorizes preparation
